content:
It's morning and I'm not moving.
A fainting goat goes in both ways
or seizes up when startled, even as
a global model too is a great pet. To
date, all yearlings or global models
which come up seize up when startled.
The white boom of their coming to life
(as less or more a beloved fainting goat
in a set of fainting goats) is too much :
is a missense : can't help it : goes to chevon.
On a garden swing or in a braced programme or
in a meadow of summaries for a different present,
you can pick up a fainted model of the world,
and its legs will not move, in a terrible way.
readme: Words to hum during the loss of subjecthood in the face of laughing at animals.
title: Hymn tipping
